about: Quality criteria shown on the page. 'judged' criteria are scored per home with a written reason (in listings.json → features). 'computed' criteria are derived from data/amenities.json (OpenStreetMap, district centre) using the thresholds below. 'space' is computed from living area.

criteria.label: Visiting family
criteria.what: Can parents stay for weeks without everyone getting in each other's way? Own room, own bathroom, ideally own door and kitchen.

scale.5: Separate flat or studio with own bath (and kitchen)
scale.4: Guest room with its own shower room

criteria.label: Home office
criteria.what: A real room with a door for working from home – on top of the bedroom and the guest room, so the office doesn't disappear when family visits.

scale.5: Office and guest room both dedicated, plus a spare room
scale.4: Office and guest room both dedicated
scale.2: Only a corner, gallery or attic nook

criteria.label: Garden & outdoor
criteria.what: Private outdoor space: a garden to sit, grow things and host; terraces count less, balconies least.

scale.4: Private garden < 300 m², or a large garden share in exclusive use
scale.3: Large terrace or roof terrace (≥ 15 m²)

criteria.label: Space
criteria.what: Living area. Computed as (m² − 90) / 20, capped at 0–5: 110 m² → 1, 130 m² → 2, 150 m² → 3, 170 m² → 4, 190 m² → 5.

criteria.label: Step-free living
criteria.what: Stairs matter for older visitors and later for ourselves: can daily life happen on one level?

scale.5: One level, ground floor or lift, no steps inside
scale.4: One level, a few steps to the door
scale.3: Several levels but a bedroom + bathroom on the entrance level
scale.2: House or maisonette with stairs for daily life

criteria.label: Condition & energy
criteria.what: How much work and money before it's nice and efficient: age, renovation state, heating type and energy demand.

scale.5: New or renovated, efficient (≤ 100 kWh/m²·yr, modern heating)
scale.2: Major work: old heating, high demand
scale.1: Full renovation, oil or electric heating

criteria.label: Quiet street
criteria.what: Traffic, rail and neighbour noise at the address, judged from the listing (cul-de-sac, through road, sound-proof windows…).

criteria.label: Preferred area
criteria.what: Our own ranking of districts: Ippendorf, Kottenforst edge, Venusberg and Röttgen first; Lengsdorf, Friesdorf, Schweinheim fine; central Godesberg okay; Mehlem/Wachtberg so-so; not keen on Heiderhof.

criteria.label: Forest & green
criteria.what: Straight-line distance from the district centre to the nearest forest (woodland ≥ 5 ha, e.g. Kottenforst) in OpenStreetMap. A park counts as a fallback one step lower.

criteria.label: Daily shopping
criteria.what: Distance to the nearest supermarket from the district centre; +0.5 if there are 3 or more within 1 km.

criteria.label: Kita & schools
criteria.what: Average of three distances from the district centre: nearest Kita, primary school (Grundschule) and secondary school (Gymnasium / Gesamtschule / Realschule).

criteria.label: Public transport
criteria.what: Nearest Stadtbahn, tram or train stop from the district centre. Without one within 1.5 km, bus coverage decides (3+ bus stops within 500 m → 2.5).

criteria.label: To the city
criteria.what: Straight-line distance from the district centre to Bonn Hauptbahnhof (≈ minutes by bike = km × 4).

criteria.label: Low risk / hassle
criteria.what: Things that can go wrong or cost time: sitting tenants, damp, big renovations, unclear service charges, legal issues.
